title: Work well but don’t last
text: Work well but don’t last. I started using these exclusively for my daily beverages just over a year ago. The insulation and light weight proved very convenient. Last night, however, one of them finally cracked in the bottom inside glass due to repeated ice cube impact over time from the fridge dispenser. Unless the bottom glass gets thickened up I wouldn’t recommend these.
